data.body: Plan-review clarification after the first corrected-plan review: the PS3 code_review_result_v2 artifact does expose Pass-2 evidence inside its advisory bucket. In .tickets-tracker/fe91-f579-710f-4e48/1785215582756011475-9dd581c3-811a-4bac-8f6f-a75078636f13-REVIEW_RESULT.json, the project-attributed entry records validity=1.0, impact=0.36, verification.binary.evidence_entails_finding=yes, and verification.binary.impact_follows_necessarily=yes, along with priority=0.36, decision=advisory, block_threshold=0.90, and blocking_enabled=false. The acceptance criteria now name these exact observable fields rather than the ambiguous phrase Pass-2 validity/impact answers.
